status: implemented locally; production release not yet verified

behavior.selectedContainer: Append the new element to that container.
behavior.selectedLeaf: Insert the new element immediately after the selected sibling.
behavior.noSelection: Append the new element to the page root.
behavior.command: The exact insertion index is recorded and preserved by undo/redo.
behavior.canvas: The Page Model child order is rendered in normal flow; the add verification checks the inserted node at the requested index.
behavior.savePublish: Draft Save persists the same order and remains separate from Publish.

chromium.covers: Actual palette clicks, selected-sibling insertion, non-overlapping desktop and mobile Canvas flow, Save order, and unpublished state.

acceptance.canonicalPlan: PASS; all 13 master files present; full 77.44.7.A acceptance remains NOT_CERTIFIED.

openSourceReview.decision: Reviewed its collection-based component insertion architecture. No code was copied and no dependency was added: the existing Page Model has a native child index and is the smaller compatible implementation.

acceptanceBoundary: The palette-to-Canvas and draft Save behavior is covered locally. Full plan acceptance, physical-device acceptance, GitHub release checks, and production deployment are not claimed by this evidence.
